# TubeMetrix — YouTube Live Stream Analytics, Super Chat Auditor & Comment Exporter
> https://tubemetrix.net/

TubeMetrix is a creator intelligence and data extraction platform developed by **RedFire Corporation** ([https://redfire-corporation.pages.dev/](https://redfire-corporation.pages.dev/)) for YouTube streamers, MCN agencies, data researchers, and content creators. It allows users to audit live stream monetization (Super Chats, Super Stickers, Channel Memberships, and YouTube Jewels/Rubies) and export complete live chat replays and video/Shorts comments to formatted Excel (.xls), CSV, TXT, and JSON.

## Publisher & Parent Organization
- **Company:** [RedFire Corporation](https://redfire-corporation.pages.dev/) (Software Development, Jaipur, India)
- **Official Profiles:** [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/redfire-corporation/) | [X / Twitter (@RedFire_Corp)](https://x.com/RedFire_Corp) | [Reddit (u/RedFireCorp)](https://www.reddit.com/user/RedFireCorp/)

## Core Tools & URLs
- [Live Stream Earnings & Super Chat Auditor](https://tubemetrix.net/): Calculate exact gross and 70% net creator revenue from Super Chats, Memberships, and YouTube Jewels across single streams or channel date ranges.
- [Live Chat & Comments Downloader](https://tubemetrix.net/chats): Extract complete live stream chat replays with timestamps and standard video/Shorts comments with likes and replies.
- [Export YouTube Comments to Excel](https://tubemetrix.net/export-youtube-comments-to-excel): Dedicated one-click exporter creating Microsoft Excel (.xls) and UTF-8 BOM CSV spreadsheets from YouTube videos and live streams.
- [YouTube Live Chat Downloader](https://tubemetrix.net/download-youtube-live-chat): Download timestamped live chat replays with Super Chat donation flags.
- [YouTube Shorts Comments Downloader](https://tubemetrix.net/download-youtube-shorts-comments): Scrape comments, reply threads, and pinned statuses from mobile vertical YouTube Shorts URLs.
- [Bulk YouTube Comment Downloader](https://tubemetrix.net/bulk-youtube-comment-downloader): Multi-URL batch extraction queue for agencies and NLP sentiment researchers.
- [Channel Stream & Date Range Downloader](https://tubemetrix.net/channel-comments-downloader): Filter any creator channel by 7D, 30D, or 90D date windows and export all historical streams.
- [YouTube Channel Stats & Revenue Estimator](https://tubemetrix.net/revenue): Real-time channel analytics, subscriber velocity, and SocialBlade alternative comparison tool.
- [YouTube Jewels & Rubies Calculator](https://tubemetrix.net/youtube-jewels-calculator): Official 2 Jewels = 1 Ruby ($0.01 USD / ~₹0.84 INR) conversion tool for YouTube Live Gifts.

## Pricing Advantage vs Competitors
- **Free Tier:** 2 one-time Guest audits/downloads + 3 free Single Stream runs per week with Google Sign-In (up to 1,000 video comments or full single stream Super Chat audit).
- **Prepaid Credits (Pay-As-You-Go):** Never-expiring credit packs starting at **₹49 / $2.99 USD** (10 Credits = up to 10,000 comments or 30,000 live chats or 10 full stream revenue audits). Zero forced monthly subscriptions.
- **Comparison:** Up to 10x cheaper than competitors like YouTubeCommentsDownloader ($29 minimum / $79/mo), ExportComments ($30 pass / $50–$220/mo), and Outscraper ($3 per 1,000 comments), while uniquely including full financial monetization parsing.
